child_finding.explanation: Off-by-one at the threshold: the code uses 'total_cents > 10_000', but the contract says totals greater than or equal to 10_000 get the 10% discount. So exactly 10000 is returned with no discount instead of 10000 * 90 // 100 = 9000. Fix: use '>='.

limits: Transcript proves lifecycle tool execution and returned child result, not effective provider request settings.
